purpose: Reject already-consumed return-serial, signed-efficiency, price-impact-ratio, and window variants before values and select one economically distinct within-bar transaction-price-pressure mechanism for the next ordered no-return audit.

closest_existing_mechanisms.late_vwap_to_day_vwap_30m: Compares the aggregate final-30-minute VWAP level with the aggregate full-day VWAP level. The selected candidate instead compares each active minute close with that same minute's transaction VWAP and then aggregates those within-bar signed gaps over the full session.
closest_existing_mechanisms.afternoon_signed_amount_efficiency_120m: Weights adjacent close-to-close returns by destination-bar amount in the afternoon. The selected candidate has no previous-close return and measures close versus same-bar executed average price.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_up_move_amount_share_238m: Allocates amount according to the sign of adjacent close-to-close returns. The selected candidate can be positive or negative even when the adjacent return is zero because its reference is the same bar's VWAP.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p: Correlates amount magnitude with absolute adjacent-return magnitude across minutes. The selected candidate is signed, uses the within-bar close-to-VWAP gap, and is an amount-weighted mean rather than a cross-minute correlation.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_realized_volatility: Measures total adjacent-return magnitude and does not use same-bar transaction VWAP.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_return_skewness_238m: Measures the third central moment of adjacent returns and is independent of transaction amount and volume.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: intraday_return_autocorrelation
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: First-order correlation between adjacent within-half minute returns
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: The terminal return-sign-run preregistration already rejected lagged return autocorrelation as same-mechanism formula search, so it cannot be reopened as a new candidate.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: intraday_realized_volatility_to_amount_or_amihud_ratio
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Total absolute or squared minute return divided by session amount
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: The amount-volatility-coupling mechanism audit already rejected this scale-sensitive overlap with realized volatility, daily liquidity, and size.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: full_session_directional_efficiency
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Net minute return divided by total absolute minute return, with or without amount weights
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: The diffusive-variation mechanism audit already rejected this as a sampling-frequency and weighting variant of terminal daily and afternoon signed-efficiency factors.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: absolute_or_squared_bar_vwap_dislocation
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Mean absolute or squared log close-to-same-bar-VWAP gap
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Discarding sign changes the selected buyer-versus-seller pressure mechanism into a liquidity-noise statistic and creates direction search against already-terminal volatility and liquidity branches.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: morning_afternoon_late_or_opening_bar_vwap_pressure
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Compute the same signed close-to-bar-VWAP gap on a selected subwindow or include the ambiguous 09:30 row
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Window selection is formula search and 09:30 has known zero-activity placeholder ambiguity.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: source_high_low_close_location
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Use source minute high or low to locate the close inside each bar
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Historical source high and low fields failed the original daily reconciliation and are forbidden for this cleaned branch.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_bar_vwap_close_pressure_240m
selected_candidate.formula: Sum(amount_t * log(close_t / (amount_t / volume_t))) / Sum(amount_t) over active bars t at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00
selected_candidate.activity_rule: A bar is active only when both normalized share volume and CNY amount are strictly positive. A zero-volume and zero-amount bar receives zero weight. A one-sided zero or any negative/nonfinite required value makes the stock-day ineligible.
selected_candidate.mechanism: Within-bar close pressure measures whether economically weighted active minutes ended above or below their own executed average transaction price, isolating buyer-versus-seller urgency near minute closes.
selected_candidate.hypothesis: A high close-known value indicates repeated buyer urgency within active bars, with transaction-weighted closes above same-bar VWAP, which may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: The candidate uses the same-minute transaction-price reference rather than a previous close, a daily VWAP, a path endpoint, or a return-distribution moment. It is invariant to a common positive rescaling of all amounts and to the stock's absolute price scale, while retaining the sign of within-bar execution pressure.
